variables.name: border/low
variables.description: Default border. Opacity-based: adapts to any surface. Light: Black/Alpha/15, Dark: White/Alpha/15.

variables.name: divider/subtle
variables.description: Horizontal rule / separator line — default weight. Translucent to work on any surface.

variables.name: divider/medium
variables.description: Horizontal rule / separator line — stronger weight for section breaks.

variables.name: Transparent/Full
variables.description: Fully transparent — rgba(0,0,0,0). Use for invisible fills where a bound variable is required.

variables.name: divider/strong
variables.description: Divider line — full opacity. Pure black (light) / pure white (dark). Use for maximum contrast dividers on image or brand surfaces.

variables.name: divider/none
variables.description: Divider line — invisible. Transparent fill. Use when spacing is needed but the line should not be visible (Low mode in Border collection).

variables.name: color
variables.description: Divider line colour. Switch modes to control opacity: Full=60%, High=40%, Medium=20%, Low=transparent. Light/Dark awareness comes from the Semantic divider/* tokens this aliases.

variables.name: Black/Alpha/15
variables.description: Black at 15% opacity. Use for border/default opacity equivalent on light surfaces.

variables.name: White/Alpha/15
variables.description: White at 15% opacity. Use for border/default opacity equivalent on dark surfaces.

variables.name: text/primary
variables.description: Reflects the text.primary variable from the theme object
